gt_provenance.details: Authored specification reference reproduces reference.ts and differs from API response-derived base. All three candidates derive from that one base. Wire-bound judge inputs exclude source/private labels; repair inputs contain actual candidate and public feedback.

result_existence.details: 609 local checks, zero failed; all nine ledgers reconcile. All compared prompts and PNGs bind to true observation prefixes. Fifteen SSE files independently reconstruct archived response content, usage and finish reason. External provider identity/billing not attested.

dead_code.details: Stored response applies exactly to repaired candidate/final source; next verifier directory contains four fresh observations. Root local replay outputs inspected directly: 258 checks, 22 of 22 PNGs exact; all six arms rescored.

scope.details: One object, one API base, two injected faults, one sample per arm; adaptive pilot and segmented recovery. K counts actions, not free public context or API compute. Fixed K=4 never observes door. Global detection metric differs from observed-scope pass semantics. No source-only/no-diagnosis control isolates repair attribution.

findings.judgment: Front view changes a vertical door into a horizontal thin strip, supporting an X-like axis rather than Y. Exact anchor and all dimensions do not follow from this image alone.
Screen-left displacement in oblique view does not establish world -X; source and world replay give pure +Z. This is a true false-positive interpretation.
Offset is visually present; rest placement consistency claims overstate observed agreement. Both missed an existing drawer X offset.

claims.qualifier: Bounded simulation and locally archived API chain only.
Known tokens only; currency and four missing usage entries remain unknown.
Equal actions per round, shared free context; not equal compute, tokens or total observations.
